main_text.head: LIBRI I.
CAPITA TRIVM LIBRORVM
main_text.p: Brudi Lusitani de ratione victus febricitantium.
main_text.head: LIBRI PRIMI CAPITA
CAP. I.
main_text.p: Disceptationem continet, an crasso victu alendi sint acute febricitantes, vt arbitratus est Petronas, pro quo variæ rationes hic adferuntur, pagina 416.
main_text.head: CAP. II.
main_text.p: Quod tenui victu alendi sint acute febricitantes, iuxta rationalium medicorum sententiam. 448.
main_text.head: CAP. III.
main_text.p: Ostendit quid per crassum, tenuè, exacte tenuem, tenuissimum, vltimo tenuissimum, victum Hipp. intelligat. 452.
main_text.head: CAP. IIII.
main_text.p: Ostendit qualiter sint intelligendæ crassi, symmetri, & tenuis victus notiones, quas Galenus primo Aphorismo assignauit. 457.
main_text.head: CAP. V.
main_text.p: Locum citat Galeni à quo ostenditur qualiter intelligenda sit tenuis victus ratio:

page.notes: Greek line partly illegible; the printed text reads roughly "ἢ δ᾽ ἐκ καθαρᾶς ... λεπτὴν" and is copied as best read. The page numbers at the right of the index are printed in a column beside the entries; "[illegible]" not required. The "Quod" at lower right is a catchword. Some ink show-through and stains are present and were ignored. The index layout was reduced to lines; the exact dot/column alignment is approximate.
